name: helix-gtm-suite
description: For founders, CMOs and revenue teams at growth stage B2B firms: decide which go-to-market motion should lead, which customers to target, how to position, whether a deal or account is at risk, and what you can publish. All 89 free B2B GTM tools and skills by Shashwat Ghosh (Helix GTM Consulting): 52 tools in 6 hosted MCP connectors and the 37 skills of 9 Claude plugins, plus companion skills.
author: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://gtmhelix.com)

gtm-alpha.description: 3 deterministic B2B go-to-market motion scoring and 180-day roadmap tools powered by the EPIC Framework.

craft-gtm.description: 10 strategic B2B GTM execution tools powered by the CRAFT Framework (Character, Result, Artifact, Frame, Timeline).

craft-content.description: 9 B2B content creation and repurposing tools powered by the CRAFT Framework.

impact.description: 9 hypothesis-driven B2B positioning and messaging tools covering all 6 steps of the IMPACT Framework.

icp-intelligence.description: 9 deep ICP pattern detection, market sizing, buying group, and account prioritization tools.

revenue-enablement.description: 12 B2B deal execution, MEDDPICC discovery, CFO ROI business case, and seller enablement tools.
